candidats.description: OKINAWA, JAPAN (Sept. 29, 2008) Builder 3rd Class Christopher Dutra, left, and Utilitiesman 3rd Class Thomas E. Hanson, from Naval Mobile Construction Battalion (NMCB) 133, tie a rebar cage together using tie wire and a pair of lineman's pliers while building a Morale, Welfare & Recreation warehouse at White Beach Naval Facility in Okinawa. NMCB-133 is on a seven-month deployment. (U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist Chief Petty Officer Ryan C. Delcore/Released)
